name: robot-console
description: GUI for managing micro:bit robots built on the Elecfreaks Nezha differential-drive board.

scripts.pretest: git submodule update --init 2>/dev/null || true && npm run build -w @robot-console/protocol
scripts.build: npm run build -w @robot-console/protocol && npm run build -w @robot-console/host && npm run build -w @robot-console/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @robot-console/protocol && npm run build -w @robot-console/host && tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/host/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json
